title: Is the guidance on Organization Security Requirements still current?

question.author: member_296
question.body: I found an older discussion about organization security requirements. Can someone confirm the current CloudBox behavior?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Team Accounts documentation says: Organizations on Business and Enterprise plans can additionally enable SSO (SAML or OIDC), which centralizes sign-in but does not replace the 2FA requirement. Admins can audit devices and sessions from the admin console and remotely sign out a lost laptop. All organization accounts must enroll in two-factor authentication; this requirement took effect with CloudBox 2.1 and applies to every member, including guests. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
